Lane Stewart (born August 24, 1987) is an American director, producer, photographer, artistic director, and co-founder of the record label Halcyon Veil.
Career
Filmmaking
Stewart has directed films for Jerry Lorenzo and the Fear of God (clothing) brand.
Art Director
Stewart is the art director for the Halcyon Veil record label he cofounded.
